prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: Once a man came to sick people. The sick ones said: "Aren't you a shaman, shamanize us". "I'll shamanize, though, [but] it won't heal, there is no sacrifice!" The sick ones made him shamanize, having killed a reindeer. Their shaman stopped shamanizing and said: "Within three days you'll be fine". The shaman went off in the morning. The sick ones gave him a reindeer and cloths. The shaman was riding the reindeer and came home, he boasted [that] he had deceived the people having become a shaman.
